Subject: Coord: ApexCloud GSI-led technical deep-dive & marketplace next steps

Hi Elena — great to connect today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary (30m call)
- ApexCloud is evaluating Redwood for a marketplace-integrated inference layer for partner-managed deployments.
- Primary drivers: predictable latency SLAs for third-party tenants, cost caps per workload, and tighter observability for tenant-level billing.
- GSI (Jared) will want a short technical deep-dive to validate routing/fallback behavior and Dedicated capacity sizing.

Action items / ask
1) Schedule a 60–75m GSI-led technical deep-dive with Jared (Apex) + our infra eng (Camila) and solutions (Ben).
2) Please confirm the list of systems you want covered (routing, KV cache behavior, Dedicated autoscale policy, marketplace provisioning flow).
3) Attach any compliance/marketplace onboarding docs you want us to review ahead of the call.

Proposed slots (PST) — pick two that work for Jared + your infra lead:
- Tue Apr 27: 09:00–10:15 or 13:30–14:45
- Wed Apr 28: 11:00–12:15 or 15:00–16:15

If none work, share a Calendly or a couple alternatives and I’ll loop in Camila to align.

Thanks — I’ll put tentative hold on Camila/Ben calendar for the top two slots until I hear back.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

- Agenda must cover marketplace tenant provisioning flow + role-based access for GSI operators (15m)
- We’d like to see a short sketch of Dedicated autoscaling and a Q&A on billing attribution (20m)
- Please include any pre-read about supported quantization profiles for multi-tenant workloads.

Top choices for us (PST):
1) Tue Apr 27, 13:30–14:45 (preferred)
2) Wed Apr 28, 11:00–12:15

I’ve looped in Jared. I’ll also pull Carlos into the thread once I confirm his availability for Tue afternoon (should be OK).

Also attaching a short APAC marketplace checklist that the GSI team requested — it has a couple of onboarding constraints to glance at.

Best,

Thanks — confirmed from our side.

I’ll lead the deep-dive. Proposed agenda (60–75m):
- 0–10m: Introductions and success criteria
- 10–30m: Marketplace provisioning flow + role model (Camila)
- 30–50m: Dedicated autoscale & routing behavior (Ben)
- 50–65m: Billing attribution and SLOs (Vivek + Ben)
- 65–75m: Open Q&A and next-step action owners

We can circulate a short pre-read (2 pages) explaining how Redwood’s Dedicated capacity maps to marketplace tenants and how prefix/KV caching interacts with multi-tenant autoscaling. I’ll attach that and a draft POC scope for you to review.

Provisional calendar invite: Tue Apr 27, 13:30–14:45 PST — I’ll convert to your TZ and send the invite once Carlos confirms.

Attachments: apex_poc_scope.xlsx
